_doc: The game's menus (src/game_view/hud_menu.cpp): main menu, pause, saves, settings.
menu.title: Altera
menu.tagline: The life of one village at the edge of the old world
menu.hint: Esc in the game opens the pause menu and saving
menu.save.title: Save the game
menu.load.title: Load a game
menu.slot.overwrite: This slot is taken: click again to overwrite
menu.world.title: A new world
menu.world.hint: Choose what the world will be. Its map is on the right: the world will be exactly that. A new world is built when the game starts on it (a few dozen seconds), then it opens at once.
menu.world.lore_note: The predefined world of Altera: a hand-made continent 131 km across. Its size and the rest are its own.
menu.world.lore_map: The world of Altera: 131 km, its own ranges, marshes and canyons
menu.world.facts: {km}×{km} km, land {land}%, peaks up to {peak} m
menu.world.weak: This one is poor for a village: making it takes the nearest variant of the seed that passes the checks.
